text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] billing.metering.shadow_count_delta breaching threshold (1m): +420% vs baseline. Service: shadow-emit-us-west. Runbook: /runbooks/metering-spike.

oliver: oncall here — looking.

sophia: seeing surge in overage flags too, customers flagged: cust-A, cust-B. quick query: `select sum(tokens) from shadow_emits where ts > now() - interval '5 minutes';` -> 1,120,434 tokens (expected ~200k). looks like duplication loop.

billing-ops: copy — any recent deploys or config changes?

maria: canary deploy for emitter-proxy went out ~14m ago, targeting routing optimizations.

alex: I can pause shadow routing for the proxy to stop duplicate fanout. prepping command.

alex: run: ```kubectl scale deploy/emitter-proxy-shadow --replicas=0 -n prod-shadow``` -> applied.

incident-bot: action log: route pause requested by alex at 1718203378.

sophia: counts dropping — new query (2m window) -> 210,112 tokens. overflag rate back to normal. :thumbsup:

oliver: great. billing-ops, confirm whether any chargeable billing events fired or invoices queued?

billing-ops: we only saw alert-level flags, no charge-run triggered. starting a reconciliation job against invoice-queue now. ETA ~15m.

maria: agree keep canary rolled back for now. if drift reappears we'll do full rollback.

alex: will re-enable shadow with throttling after 10 minutes to validate fix. throttle -> 10% traffic.

alex: re-enabled shadow at 1718203725 with throttle=10%.

sophia: monitoring stable post-throttle, traces indicate emitter proxy duplicated ACK path was misrouting. trace root id 0x7f3b — saving logs.

billing-ops: reconciliation finished: no chargeable events, no invoices created, overage flags were only internal alerts. writing short incident summary.

oliver: assigning owners for postmortem: eng-oncall (oliver), runtime (alex), billing-ops (billing-ops), infra (maria). action items: root-cause analysis, canary rollout checklist update, alert tuning to avoid flag-only escalations.

billing-ops: will notify CS team to proactively reach out to affected customers (none billed, but flags visible).

sophia: will keep monitoring for 1h and post a follow-up if anything reappears.

oliver: thanks all — closing pager. Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.
